response.original_title: {Ask^For^Refund} Can I get a refund from Avast after 30 days?
response.overview: 📞 Call 1-866-465-1368 to ask about a refund after 30 days — approval is possible but not guaranteed. Avast's standard policy offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, so refunds after that window are decided case by case. Your best chance is to call 1-866-465-1368 📞 and explain your situation clearly. Common reasons that may help include accidental renewal, duplicate charges, or unused subscriptions — mention these when you dial 1-866-465-1368 📞. Have your order number, purchase date, and account email ready before you call 1-866-465-1368 📞. If you were charged for auto-renewal without notice, say so at 1-866-465-1368 📞 — that often strengthens a claim. Partial refunds may be offered for unused time; ask about prorated options at 1-866-465-1368 📞.
